# Binding templates

<!-- Generated by scripts/templates.ts of the contract store. Do not edit. -->

These files let a binding check its OpenSpec specs and its traceability record before each commit. They come from the
spec artifact of the OSCAL bindings contract store that the binding pins (openspec/specs/binding-surface, STO-055).

## Files

1. `openspec/config.yaml`: the OpenSpec config of a binding. The contract store generates it from its own config (STO-058).
2. `openspec/spec-ids.yaml`: an empty identifier ledger.
3. `openspec/traceability.json`: a traceability record with no operation.
4. `bin/check-binding.mjs`: the binding checker (STO-056, STO-057). It runs with Node.js 22 or later and git, and
   needs no installed package.
5. `hooks/pre-commit`: a POSIX shell git hook. It verifies the pinned archive by its sha256, extracts it, and runs
   the checker of the archive and `openspec validate --all --strict` on the staged files.
6. `AGENTS.md`: the agent guide of a binding. It states how the binding relates to the contract store, and where each kind
   of change goes.
7. `bin/install.sh`: installs these files in a binding repository.

## Install

Keep the pinned spec artifact, the `.tar.gz` file, at a path in the binding repository. Extract
`templates/binding/bin/install.sh` from it, and run the script in the root directory of the binding, at the first
install and on each pin move:

```sh
sh install.sh --archive <spec artifact .tar.gz> --sha256 <hex> [--record <path>] [--hooks-dir <dir>]
```

1. It verifies the archive by its sha256. On another hash, it fails and changes no file.
2. It writes `openspec/config.yaml`, and `<hooks-dir>/pre-commit` with the archive path, the sha256 and the record
   path. The default hooks directory is `.githooks`.
3. It writes `openspec/spec-ids.yaml` and the record only when they do not exist. The default record is
   `openspec/traceability.json`.
4. It writes `AGENTS.md` from the template, and keeps its section "Binding notes". The text of an `AGENTS.md`
   without that section goes into the section.
5. It sets `core.hooksPath` to the hooks directory when `core.hooksPath` is not set.

After the first install, add the prefixes of the binding to the ledger. A prefix of the contract store is not allowed
(SRF-010). Add the facts of the binding to the section "Binding notes" of `AGENTS.md`. On each pin move, add the
entries of the binding to `openspec/config.yaml` again.

## Run the checker

```sh
node <extracted archive>/templates/binding/bin/check-binding.mjs --contract-store <extracted archive> [--record <path>]
```

Run it in the root directory of the binding. `<extracted archive>` is the top directory of the extracted spec
artifact. The default record is `openspec/traceability.json`. `SPEC_IDS_BASE` sets the git ref whose scenario
identifiers must not vanish. The default is `HEAD`. Each failure starts with the name of its rule. The exit code is 1
on a failure, 2 on a usage error, and 0 otherwise.

## Packages in the bundle

The bundle holds these packages. It keeps their license comments.

1. `ajv` 8.20.0: MIT
2. `fast-deep-equal` 3.1.3: MIT
3. `fast-uri` 3.1.8: BSD-3-Clause
4. `github-slugger` 2.0.0: ISC
5. `json-schema-traverse` 1.0.0: MIT
6. `yaml` 2.9.1: ISC
